original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: A clean scratch array caches one read-only source contribution across exactly two output ports; test whether the fully charged source-load, output-transfer, and scratch-restore channel bill can improve.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue asks for a changed helper inventory and a physically realizable full supplier. This first bounded screen isolates one new scratch helper route and proves its source-routing channel cannot improve; it supplies no full supplier and does not satisfy the catalogue admission gate.
bottleneck_link: A new helper can matter only if its fully charged channel bill creates room in the recursive moment. The one-source/two-port cache route has no channel saving after restoration, so it cannot supply that deficit reduction by itself.
stop_rule: Stop after proving the rank inequality for all 0<s<1, checking the exact finite rank domain through 64 at the two selected exponents, and passing the two-output, three-output, and omitted-restore controls. Do not generalize this one-source route to arbitrary local programs.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-exponent dimension argument; verify.py checks 220480 rank triples per exponent with outward exact rational intervals and verifies coordinate-span controls for two and three outputs plus an omitted-restore negative control.
author: Cinna Davis
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical derivation, verifier implementation, source pinning, and writing; no independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can a multi-source coded cache amortize restoration while preserving exact helper endpoints?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This changes the one-source hypothesis and could create a real supplier-level saving.
open_questions.first_step: Write a complete two-source load/use/restore frame ledger and derive its fully charged channel inequality before synthesis.
open_questions.blocked_by: No compatible multi-source endpoint contract has been supplied.

open_questions.question: Can the three-output saving control occur in an admissible changed supplier?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Three outputs evade the two-port inequality but only matter if the source support and all helper charges can be realized.
open_questions.first_step: Identify a changed supplier input column supported at three output ports and price its complete source, scratch, output, and restore bill.
open_questions.blocked_by: The selected fixed-block theorem gives two output ports per input column.
